text:
Evening night team,
Kennel cleaning came up late today, so just a quick note

Please check each carrier, replace any soiled liners, and make sure water bowls are secure before handoff. Keep the tone calm with every animal and give passengers clear guidance at the desk if they stop by with concerns.

Reminder from the floor: <<FACT F028>> Keep your notes brief and pass anything unusual to the lead before the next service move. Also, <<FACT F045>> so the pet area stays easy to identify for handovers. Please review the labels carefully and confirm that every crate is matched to the right file.

Before close, ensure the wash area is left dry, supplies are restocked, and any delayed checks are logged cleanly. <<FACT F031>> If anything looks off, flag it right away so the morning team can pick up without delay.
Companion Animal Travel Desk,
